silentAnimals.hamster: Freesound hamster.mp3 by Olivaque is CC0, but its public preview returned HTTP 403. Other hits were nest/cage noises or toys. No suitable downloadable replacement was verified on Pixabay, SoundBible or OpenGameArt.
silentAnimals.fox: Freesound real fox-call candidates were inaccessible; many are screams. SoundBible alternatives are wolves/coyotes, so were rejected. No suitable downloadable, correctly identified replacement was verified.
silentAnimals.panda: Freesound/Pixabay/OpenGameArt searches returned music, toys, human speech or red pandas rather than a verified giant-panda recording. No suitable recording obtained.
silentAnimals.turtle: Freesound/Pixabay/other-library results were turtle doves, transitions, imitations or unsuitable material; no suitable turtle recording obtained.
silentAnimals.octopus: Search results were music, ride recordings or foley with unverified downloads. No suitable natural-sounding, licensed recording obtained.
silentAnimals.crab: Freesound candidates are foley/imitations and were inaccessible; Pixabay downloads were blocked; other-library searches did not yield a suitable verified recording.
silentAnimals.triceratops: Freesound creature/dinosaur candidates were inaccessible. Pixabay downloads were blocked. No additional distinct, gentle prerecorded effect with verified redistribution rights was obtained; existing dinosaur files are not reused.
silentAnimals.stegosaurus: Freesound creature/dinosaur candidates were inaccessible. Pixabay downloads were blocked. No additional distinct, gentle prerecorded effect with verified redistribution rights was obtained; existing dinosaur files are not reused.
